correctness.rationale: Full RESULT.md, exact Jacobian product rule L=diag(2,1), R=[[0,-2],[1,0]], and one-to-one Saiki–Takahasi–Yorke symbolic periodic coding checked. Cumulative right-visit parities are a bijection of F_2^n; the monomial Jacobian has singular magnitudes 2^A,2^(n-A), where A is the parity-zero occupancy. Conditional absolute binomial histograms match for even/odd right parity; odd parity creates imaginary conjugate eigenvalues, even parity produces real diagonal eigenvalues. Removing the sole all-L fixed-face word subtracts one real maximal-gap point. The independent all-word calculation exactly multiplies the Jacobians for n=1..10; finite verification corroborates, but the bijection and binomial proof establish all n.

value.rationale: The first exact all-n spectral-class and singular-anisotropy joint distribution is a natural invariant of periodic-point derivative dynamics; it sharply distinguishes eigenvalue-based expansion from singular-value nonnormal expansion at the same return points, and its one-word extreme defect prevents a naive independence assertion on actual fixed points.

final_claim: For the two-dimensional twisted baker map, every length-n iterate-fixed isolated point (2^n-1 total) has jointly classified singular log gap and eigenvalue-modulus gap: for every allowed g the complex class has m_n(g) points with eigen-gap zero and the real class has m_n(g)-1_{g=n} points with eigen-gap g, with m_n(g)=C(n,(n-g)/2) for g>0 and half the central coefficient for g=0. Uniform isolated points have joint scaled limit (B|Z|,|Z|), B fair and independent of standard Gaussian Z.
limitations: Only dimension two, nontrivial iterate-fixed points including proper subperiods; not least-period-only or higher-dimensional joint census.
